segments.comment: Blocked for objnam.c dbterrainmesg() runtime evidence. In the source-derived Castle route, teleport.c tele_jump_ok() rejects the selected west-side coordinate because it leaves the current up-destination region; tele() then selects a random fallback instead of the bridge. Strict JS/C replay of this route diverges before the terrain wish at the wand ray: zap.c weffects() consumes C rn2(8)=6 at boundary 97 while JS has no corresponding call. The active drawbridge helper is not reached, so this recipe is not matching evidence.
